name: Camping zur Mühle
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz zur Mühle is set in a peaceful rural setting in Tyrol, named after a historic mill on the grounds. It offers pitches for motorhomes and tents in a close-to-nature atmosphere, accompanied by well-maintained sanitary facilities and a camper service station. Guests can easily undertake scenic hikes into the surrounding mountains, while families appreciate the friendly children's playground.
